inputs.label: Death Crimson OX NAOMI sets (Japan Rev A)
inputs.help: Your own sets deathcoxj.zip and naomi.zip. Leave them zipped.

steps.why: The guide has the user grant storage access.

steps.text: Open Death Crimson OX VR from Library > Unknown Sources. If it asks for storage access, allow it. Then select Play.

notes: No CHD is needed. The guide says "storage access"; MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE is assumed. The release also has a PCVR zip and a source zip.
